posts.author: LuxFerra
posts.body:
Hi everyone, so I made a thing.
An RMMV plugin to customize your title screen!
Brief overview of the current plugin features:
Window Title Command customization.
Layout
Position
Background Type
Window skin Choice
Icons
Exit command
Title Text customization.
Custom text labels with customization.
Overlays or vignettes.
Scrolling overlays and title background (parallaxes).
New!
Features to add:
Window Title Command cursor and text effects on hover.
Title text color gradient.
Tweening or easing animations.
Custom pictures or sprites.
Many more! I'll try to implement your ideas too.
Known Compatibilities and Incompatibilities:
None yet!
It'll be helpful if people help me test it especially with commonly used plugins such as Yanfly's hehe.
It's still in very early development so you can expect many updates (hopefully).
You can download the plugin
here
.

v0.2.0
Hi everyone!
The plugin has received an update, with some features such as:
Rotate text:
You can make interesting text displays by rotating them!
Window skin choice:
Use different window skin than the main one.
Exit command:
Now player can exit via command menu!
As usual, you can download it
here
.
Please let me know if you have a feedback or a request

For anyone who have downloaded the previous version (v0.1.0 or v0.2.0), you might be encountering some error codes due to my negligence, sorry about that!

posts.author: LuxFerra
posts.body:
An update to the plugin! (
v0.5.0
)
Now you can add custom pictures to the title scene. That's it, yay?
I've managed to squash some bugs too. Sorry folks, probably the error prevented you from even trying it, I hope you give the plugin a chance again.
@ElvenNeko
It has something to do with the codes for font loading, totally my bad. Now it should be fixed, I hope. Thanks for telling me!
v0.5.0:
Implemented sprite display on title scene.
Fixed font loading error.
Improved the order of layers on Scene_Title by using Promise chaining.
Fixed the error when opening Scene_Title from other scenes.
Fixed fadeout ScreenSprite position in children ordering.

Enjoy!

Custom splash screens.

posts.author: LuxFerra
posts.body:
Heya,
@natdog
!
What do you mean by "start button" is disabled?
The 'New Game' option is grayed out?
The command window doesn't appear?
The 'Press Start' screen is not showing?
Also, the plugin shouldn't modify anything if its off and even deleted. But to be exact,
you can delete it from the js folder and try again if the behaviour is still there, make sure to save too
. Currently I am unable to replicate the error.
As for the deployed version stuck on the loading screen, my hunch is that during deployment, the engine deleted assets that are being used exclusively for title scene. You need to re-add them manually.
I will update the plugin soon, didn't touch it since I thought the lack of comments means it is doing normal haha.

posts.author: LuxFerra
posts.body:
Update! (v0.6.4)
Hi everyone!
Been a while since I touched this plugin, I am sorry for the wait.
In this version I managed to fix the deployment issue, thanks to the amazing folks for answering my query regarding proper asset loading here:
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/threads/asset-loading-async-best-practices.181402
Also you no longer need to manually touch the css file to add a font. Just need to add font name and filepath!
Hopefully it can be useful for your project!

no need to touch css file to add a font
bugfixes
